title.en: Fable 18 — The Old Man and Death

sentences.ar: رجل كبير كان شايل حطب تقيل.
sentences.en: An old man was carrying heavy firewood.
He got tired and put the wood down.
He said: I wish death would come to me.

sentences.ar: خاف الرجل وقال: ساعدني أشيل الحطب.
sentences.en: The man was afraid and said: help me lift the wood.
We ask for a thing, and when it comes we are afraid.
